nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of the contract owner, set to the deployer and changed only through transferOwnership.
ERC20Basic.totalSupply: total number of minted tokens, increased by Diadem.mint.
BasicToken.balances: mapping of address to token balance, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and mint.
StandardToken.allowed: nested mapping of owner to spender to remaining allowance.
Diadem.mintingFinished: flag consulted by the canMint modifier to block further minting.
Diadem.mintAgents: mapping deciding which addresses are authorised to call mint.
Ownable constructor: assigns the deployer as the initial owner.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): owner-only transfer of contract ownership to newOwner.
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256): multiplication guarded by an overflow assertion.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256): plain division relying on Solidity's divide-by-zero revert.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256): subtraction guarded by an underflow assertion.
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256): addition guarded by an overflow assertion.
BasicToken.transfer(address,uint256): moves tokens from msg.sender to _to.
BasicToken.balanceOf(address): read-only balance lookup.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): allowance-based transfer of tokens.
StandardToken.approve(address,uint256): sets the allowance msg.sender grants to _spender.
StandardToken.allowance(address,address): read-only allowance lookup.
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address,uint): atomically adds to an existing allowance.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address,uint): atomically reduces an existing allowance.
Diadem.mint(address,uint256): mint-agent-only issuance of new tokens via onlyMintAgent and canMint.
Diadem.setMintAgent(address,bool): owner-only whitelisting of an address as mint agent.
owner = msg.sender in the constructor: unauthenticated privileged state assignment at deploy time.
require(msg.sender == owner) in the onlyOwner modifier: sole authorisation gate for privileged functions.
uint256 c = a * b followed by assert(c / a == b): integer arithmetic guarded at runtime.
assert(b <= a); return a - b: integer subtraction guarded at runtime.
uint256 c = a + b followed by assert(c >= a): integer addition guarded at runtime.
require(_value <= balances[msg.sender]) in transfer: balance precondition read before state mutation.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value: unconditional overwrite of the spender allowance.
require(mintAgents[msg.sender] == true) in the onlyMintAgent modifier: mint authorisation gate.
require(!mintingFinished) in the canMint modifier: minting enablement gate.
totalSupply = totalSupply.add(_amount) inside mint: total supply mutation.
balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_amount) inside mint: recipient balance mutation.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] = allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) in transferFrom: allowance decrement.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue): allowance increase arithmetic.
oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue): allowance decrease arithmetic after comparison with oldValue.

Constructor writes the privileged owner state variable.
transferOwnership rewrites the owner state variable.
transfer mutates sender and recipient balance entries.
transferFrom mutates the balances of _from and _to.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
increaseApproval reads and rewrites the allowance mapping.
decreaseApproval reads and rewrites the allowance mapping.
mint increases the totalSupply state variable.
mint credits the recipient balance.
setMintAgent writes the mintAgents privilege mapping.
Privileged owner assignment stores msg.sender.
Balance precondition reads the balances mapping of msg.sender.
approve unconditionally overwrites the allowance entry.
sub result feeds the debited balance update.
add result feeds the credited balance update.
Arithmetic addition updates totalSupply during mint.
Arithmetic addition updates the recipient balance during mint.
Arithmetic addition updates the allowance in increaseApproval.
Arithmetic subtraction updates the allowance in decreaseApproval.
onlyOwner gate must pass before transferOwnership body executes.
onlyMintAgent gate must pass before mint executes.
canMint gate must pass before mint executes.
Constructor execution performs the privileged owner assignment.
mul performs the guarded multiplication and assertion.
sub performs the guarded subtraction.
add performs the guarded addition.
transfer calls sub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls add to credit the recipient balance.
transfer enforces the balance precondition before mutating state.
transferFrom calls sub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls add to credit the recipient balance.
increaseApproval performs allowance increase arithmetic.
decreaseApproval performs allowance decrease arithmetic.
mint performs totalSupply addition arithmetic.
mint performs recipient balance addition arithmetic.
mul computes the local result c from the product of a and b.
div computes the local result c from a divided by b.
add computes the local result c from the sum of a and b.
balanceOf returns the stored balance through the named local balance.
decreaseApproval snapshots the current allowance into oldValue.
